# HAPI v0.29.0.4 (maintained build)

Upstream-first rebuild from `tiann/hapi` `upstream/main` at `980a921ba15665c54998a6ddb658103d467ff4cb`, with the audited self-maintained overlay, seven newly selected exact-head pull requests, and two refreshed carried heads.

## Compared with the previous maintained release

Compared with `v0.29.0.3`, this release:

- Updates carried `#1436` to restore microphone processing constraints, preserve follow-up drafts after voice resume, and merge source drafts on failed resumed sends.
- Updates carried `#1543` to retain generated-file controls in shared previews, ignore stale shared-file responses, and keep shared file links keyboard accessible.
- Carries `#1748` so late Codex app-server writes cannot escape their originating process during disconnect.
- Carries `#1750` so ambiguous queued-message cancellations remain indeterminate instead of being presented as confirmed.
- Carries `#1754` to share the existing code-wrap preference with file source previews.
- Carries `#1755` so Windows runner shutdown requires CIM-confirmed process identity before any graceful or forced stop path.
- Carries `#1757` to compact recent paths while exposing their complete value to assistive technology.
- Carries `#1760` to separate session-summary generation copy from its chat-display setting.
- Carries `#1761` to remember the file-browser tab across sessions.
- Keeps schema V29. `#1745` is deferred because its upstream V25→V26 index migration would otherwise force an isolated V30 bump for a small performance change.

## Compared with the official release

Compared with official `v0.29.0`, this build contains the maintained desktop, fleet, import, jobs, model-error, scratchlist, schema V29, protocol v2, and audited open-PR behavior already shipped in `v0.29.0.3`, plus the updates listed above.

Open-PR audit: 153 open PRs reviewed — 53 carry, 96 defer, 4 drop. Thirteen PRs are new since `v0.29.0.3`, five existing heads changed, and closed-unmerged `#1654` left the ledger. New `#1745`, `#1747`, `#1751`, `#1753`, `#1758`, and `#1759` are deferred for schema conflict, exact-head Major findings, cross-platform risk, or missing live coverage and maintainer acceptance. `#1680`, `#1597`/`#1093`, and `#1091` remain dropped; `#1320` remains permanently excluded if reopened.

## Distribution

This is a standalone four-part maintained release; it is not published to npm. Its implicit standalone fleet-upgrade channel is therefore disabled, while explicit overrides remain authoritative. Optional platform packages remain pinned to official `0.29.0`.

Expected artifacts:

- CLI archives for Linux, macOS, and Windows
- Signed macOS CLI archives
- Windows and macOS desktop bundles
- `checksums.txt`
